plan.objective: Orders of one hundred pounds or more should not be charged for delivery, and every other order should be charged three pounds
expectedTests: test/total.test.js
plan.intent: Unchanged in substance from the previous plan. The canonical change since it was written (sequence 5, 6ebaf11) touched only src/format/money.js and test/money.test.js (roundMoney/formatMoney/PLACES — rounding every customer-facing amount to whole pence). This plan claims neither file, so no file assumptions go stale: roundMoney remains an unchanged upstream helper that src/pricing/total.js calls and that this task neither edits nor re-specifies. Its stricter two-decimal rounding is behaviour-neutral for the values in play here, since all expected totals in test/total.test.js are whole pounds. The earlier account-search (src/search/accounts.js) and audit-log (src/audit/log.js) changes remain unrelated to pricing. Work to do: add a conditional free-delivery rule in src/pricing/total.js. The module currently applies an unconditional flat HANDLING charge of 2 summed with DELIVERY in `const withFees = discounted + DELIVERY + HANDLING;`. Keep DELIVERY = 3 and HANDLING = 2 as they are, add a new FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD = 100, and make only the delivery component conditional — charge 0 delivery when the post-discount goods subtotal (`discounted`) is >= FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD and 3 otherwise, while HANDLING continues to be added to every order including free-delivery and empty ones. Tax is still computed on the goods subtotal plus whatever fees are charged, and the result stays rounded via the existing roundMoney helper (call site unchanged). Extend test/total.test.js with cases below, exactly at (100 must be free), and above the threshold, asserting the handling charge still applies at and above the threshold; the four existing tests ("an order total is a positive number", "a bigger basket costs more than a smaller one", "a total includes the flat handling charge", "an empty basket still pays delivery and handling") all use sub-100 baskets and must keep their current expected values (54 and 6) unchanged. No other module, test file, API, schema, or config changes.
